architectChecks.park: Tricklers: PASS on the real binary at head: 30 unauthenticated tricklers, honest writes at 5/15/30/45 s answered 201 in 0.080-0.091 s, tricklers 400 at 60.03-61.52 s; 3 MiB upload at 44.8 KB/s answered 201 after 70.3 s (1176657a the same, since round 12's fix). Arrival order: on the real binary (order.py, a write whose body trickled 1.5 s, 24 writes holding every unit on a locked issue, 4 later writes on a free issue, release at 1.9 s) the trickled write committed first at head in 2 runs, but also at 1176657a in 2 runs, so this probe does not tell the builds apart. The discriminating evidence is admission's tests: TestAnEarlierArrivalIsQueuedAheadOfLaterOnesAlreadyWaiting and TestAResumedTicketIsGrantedAheadOfLaterArrivals fail with queue() replaced by PushBack ('a queued request was never answered', 'the parked ticket never resumed, though it arrived before the queued write'), TestAQueuedThenParkedRequestWaitsOnceOverAll fails with a full wait per ask ('waited 1.000306702s more after 600ms in the queue'). Read in the code: the wait budget counts queue time only (Arrival.waited), not time the body took, so a slow honest upload is not refused for its transfer time. Refused after admission: see failure 2a.
